narration: She survived Titanic. Then its sister ship sank beneath her.
In nineteen twelve, stewardess Violet Jessop escaped the Titanic in a lifeboat.
Four years later, she was serving aboard its sister ship, Britannic.
An explosion struck. The hospital ship began sinking in the Aegean Sea.
Her lifeboat was pulled toward the ship's still turning propellers.
Violet jumped into the water. Injured, she was pulled into another boat.
After the war, she returned to sea. Surviving two sinking ships hadn't ended her career.
